<p>-₩9,870,000 has been deposited.</p><p>-₩4,000,000 has been deposited.</p><p>-₩6,250,000 has been deposited.</p><p>"Nice."</p><p>After confirming the text messages about the deposits into my account, I grabbed the can of beer on my desk and chugged it down.</p><p>‘22-year-old B-rank freelance Hunter, Yoon Seong-hyeon’—that’s my pathetic profile.</p><p>Fifteen years ago, my parents got divorced.</p><p>My father told me my mother left him because his business failed, but by the time I reached middle school, I found out the real reason was his infidelity and his worthless personality. In the end, after a messy custody battle, he managed to win my guardianship, and that’s how I ended up living alone with him, separated from my mother, older sister, and younger sister.</p><p>The last memory I have of my mother is her tear-streaked face as she promised she’d definitely come back for me. But as time passed, her face grew fuzzy in my mind, and all that remained was the vague recollection of how exhausted she looked, even at such a young age, as she made that promise.</p><p>The only sight I ever saw at home was my father’s pathetic, powerless back as he sat in front of the TV all day, empty soju bottles scattered on the floor.</p><p>Just as my life was spiraling into ruin, the world changed dramatically.</p><p>Eight years ago, portals called Gates began appearing all over the world.</p><p>At first, each country sent in their militaries, but they were helpless against the monsters inside the Gates. Eventually, the monsters poured out, turning human territory into wastelands.</p><p>But at the same time, humans began to awaken—beings known as Awakened Ones.</p><p>People with the strength to stand against the monsters… we call them Hunters.</p><p>I, too, awakened in my first year of middle school and was immediately designated a state-protected individual. I was separated from my father and spent my school years at a state-run Hunter Training Academy.</p><p>While I was training at the academy, I heard that my father had taken out loans and fled the country. I never saw him again after that.</p><p>Once the situation stabilized somewhat, humanity realized that the resources coming out of the Gates were incredibly valuable.</p><p>Gates, filled with materials that human science couldn’t explain, soon became humanity’s treasure trove.</p><p>But honestly, none of that matters to me.</p><p>All I want is a peaceful life.</p><p>As a freelance Hunter, I take on requests, enter Gates, and earn hefty rewards.</p><p>Then I spend that money on whatever I want to eat or buy, living each day in peaceful contentment. That’s my goal in life.</p><p>‘Maybe I should take a break for a while. Maybe even go on a trip abroad.’</p><p>I was digging through my folders as usual, searching for today’s adult content, when the intercom suddenly started ringing.</p><p>Ding~</p><p>'Who could it be at this hour? I didn’t order any deliveries...'</p><p>On the intercom screen stood a woman.</p><p>'She doesn’t look like someone from the Hunter Association. Maybe she has the wrong address?'</p><p>"Who is it?"</p><p>When I opened the door, a beautiful woman stood before me.</p><p>She had long black hair down to her shoulders and wore modest clothing, but her voluptuous figure was impossible to hide. She looked to be in her late twenties.</p><p>"···."</p><p>The woman just stood there, staring at me.</p><p>There was an inexplicable sense of familiarity and warmth, but no matter how hard I thought, I couldn’t place who she was.</p><p>"Uh…?"</p><p>At that moment, the woman pulled me into a hug and began to sob.</p><p>"I—I’m sorry, but what is this…?"</p><p>"Seong-hyeon-ah, Mom was too late, wasn’t she? I’m sorry, I’m so sorry…"</p><p>"Huh? What?!"</p><p>I gently pushed the woman—who had called herself my mom—away and examined her face again.</p><p>A vague memory from 15 years ago surfaced.</p><p>'No way… it’s really Mom…'</p><p>Funny enough, after 15 years, the first thought that crossed my mind upon seeing her wasn’t joy, but admiration.</p><p>'I heard Mom married Dad after they had an accident when he was her college tutor, but even so… she looks exactly the same as she did 15 years ago. She’s supposed to be in her late thirties, but she doesn’t look a day over twenty.'</p><p>"Huuuh… h-hic, Seong-hyeon-ah, Mom is so sorry, I was too late, wasn’t I? I really wanted to come see you once things settled down, but when I went looking, that bastard had already fled overseas. And the police kept refusing to tell me anything because you were in the Hunter Training Academy and under personal protection… It’s true, I never stopped looking for you…"</p><p>Mom seemed to think I’d resent her, so she kept glancing at me as she spoke.</p><p>"Now we can finally live together… my son… my Seong-hyeon-ah, Mom was too late, wasn’t she?"</p><p>"No, it’s just… this is too sudden."</p><p>Seeing her in person did make me happy, but the sudden suggestion of living together caught me off guard.</p><p>'Hunter candidates have strict personal protection, so it makes sense that a regular person without connections to the Association couldn’t find me. I *am* happy to see her, but my life right now is already perfect. Living together… that’s a bit much. I should let her down gently.'</p><p>"It’s been a long time, Mom. I understand you had your reasons. But suddenly living together…"</p><p>"No, we’re never separating again."</p><p>"Wha...?"</p><p>Mom suddenly spoke with a firm tone.</p><p>"Let’s go home."</p><p>"Huh?"</p><p>***</p><p>"Son~ come out and eat~."</p><p>"Okay."</p><p>A week had passed since I came to Mom’s house.</p><p>In the end, I couldn’t bring myself to refuse her offer that day, so I ended up here.</p><p>Was I missing my family? Or was I just lonely? I still don’t really know why I made that choice, but having someone make me meals every morning wasn’t so bad.</p><p>"Hey! Hurry up and come out! We’re all waiting because of you!"</p><p>The one snapping at me the second I stepped out of my room was Yoon Ji-hyeon, my little sister I hadn’t seen in 15 years.</p><p>She said she was retaking the college entrance exam, but I wasn’t sure if she was just stressed from that or if she genuinely disliked me—she was always in a foul mood whenever she saw me.</p><p>"Seong-hyeon, you should understand. Ji-hyeon’s just embarrassed and happy to see her oppa after so long."</p><p>"Ah! Unni! That’s not it at all, it’s just annoying!"</p><p>The blonde beauty teasing Yoon Ji-hyeon was Yoon Na-hyeon, my older sister by one year.</p><p>Her voice was soft, but her body was anything but—her shirt looked like it might burst at any moment thanks to her enormous chest. She was currently a university student, a top performer in Korea University’s Hunter Administration Department, and her goal was to work at the Hunter Association after graduation.</p><p>'Wow... I still can’t get used to those tits every time I see them.'</p><p>"Kids, let’s eat."</p><p>"I’ll dig in."</p><p>Lastly, there was my mother, Seong Yu-na, whose ageless beauty still surprised me every time I saw her.</p><p>'Damn, it’s all in the genes.'</p><p>In any case, every woman in this household—mother and daughters alike—was a busty beauty.</p><p>Any man living with women like these would be in absolute paradise.</p><p>***</p><p>After breakfast, Yoon Ji-hyeon left for her academy, Na-hyeon for university, and Mom for work.</p><p>Since I had no plans to do any Hunter work, I would’ve normally spent my days glued to my phone, scrolling through short videos to pass the time... but...</p><p>"Fuck... this is driving me crazy."</p><p>This was the time I usually masturbated.</p><p>To a 22-year-old single man like me, the women in this house were an overwhelming presence.</p><p>Even if they were family, after 15 years apart, it was no different from living with three beautiful, well-built women.</p><p>Especially a few nights ago, when I came out to the living room for water and accidentally saw my mom after her shower, barely covered by a robe. That was the final blow.</p><p>Ever since then, I’ve been closing my eyes at this time every day, reliving that moment as I jerk off.</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290629" loading="lazy">
</p><p>"Haaah… Mom… Nnngh…!"</p><p>Squelch-squelch</p><p>*How the hell is that the body of a woman in her late 30s?*</p><p>After awakening as a Hunter, this damn body of mine couldn’t be satisfied with just pulling out once. On top of that, as a single man who’d never seen a naked woman before, the first one I saw had to be a body that violent. It was a problem.</p><p>So every day, I masturbated, tangled in guilt and depravity.</p><p>*Alright, time to get to work.*</p><p>I disposed of the tissue soaked in cum, got dressed, and stepped outside.</p><p>There was another problem I needed to solve besides my mom.</p><p>On my first day here, I saw debt collection texts constantly flooding my mom’s phone.</p><p>Just in case, when no one was home, I searched her room and found out she was in debt. And not just any debt—she’d borrowed from loan sharks…</p><p>I called the loan shark’s number and asked how she ended up in this mess.</p><p>Turns out, my mom used to run a restaurant. Business was going better than expected, so she decided to expand and took out a bank loan.</p><p>Maybe she thought everything would work out, but in the end, she even took out a loan to buy this house. At first, business was good, but then things started going downhill. To stop the house from going into foreclosure, she borrowed from loan sharks to pay off the bank, but the restaurant’s situation never improved. Eventually, she had to close the place, leaving only the debt behind.</p><p>Now, every penny she earns from working nonstop goes toward the massive monthly interest, and the debt shows no sign of ever being paid off.</p><p>*Fuck… we’re gonna end up separated the second we reunite, aren’t we?*</p><p>In the end, I came here to talk to the loan shark about settling the debt.</p><p>*This building’s second floor, right…?*</p><p>I climbed the stairs of the shabby, grimy commercial building and knocked. A hulking, intimidating man opened the door.</p><p>"…"</p><p>"I’m the one who called earlier."</p><p>"Please, come this way."</p><p>The loan shark’s office was cleaner and more elegant than I had expected.</p><p>"Oh dear, customer! Please, have a seat here. Someone, bring some coffee."</p><p>Unlike what I’d imagined, the loan shark looked quite respectable.</p><p>"No, I’m fine without anything to drink. I came to settle Seong Yu-na’s debt."</p><p>"Just once?"</p><p>"Yes."</p><p>The loan shark’s expression showed a hint of surprise.</p><p>Since they’d said they couldn’t disclose the debt amount over the phone for security reasons, I had no idea how much it was.</p><p>"Yes, so how much is it?"</p><p>The loan shark began flipping through a file labeled "Seong Yu-na."</p><p>'Well, even at the absolute max, it can’t be more than 100 million won. Maybe 150 million at most...'</p><p>"Let me see... For customer Seong Yu-na... the principal is 280 million, and with interest, that comes to 434,320,000 won."</p><p>"What?"</p><p>The amount was so far beyond my expectations that my brain short-circuited.</p><p>The loan shark kindly showed me the contract and explained each detail.</p><p>"Haa..."</p><p>"It might be a bit difficult to repay all at once..."</p><p>"No, I’ll pay it all right now."</p><p>With trembling hands, I opened my banking app and transferred the full debt amount to the loan shark’s account.</p><p>"Oh my, you’ve got deep pockets... To transfer that much without any limit or restriction, you must be a Hunter, right?"</p><p>"Yeah, well. And since you’re receiving this through an account, you must be a Hunter too, boss."</p><p>"I’ve retired."</p><p>The underworld had long since been taken over by Awakened.</p><p>"So, we’re done here, then?"</p><p>"Of course. Feel free to come back anytime if you need emergency funds."</p><p>"Sure."</p><p>I did my best to act cool as I left the office, but I couldn’t shake the hollow feeling in my chest.</p><p>In an instant, the 450 million won I’d saved up over three years of working as a Hunter was gone.</p><p>'I don’t even know anymore. What now.'</p><p>It was disheartening, but for the first time in my life, I had protected my family. That thought alone kept my mood from souring completely.</p>
